name: Recursive dnd-kit Kanban Board Example
summary: Next.js Kanban board example that generates its drag-and-drop columns recursively, built with @dnd-kit, Tailwind and shadcn/ui.
description: An accessible drag-and-drop Kanban board example whose columns are generated recursively instead of being fixed in number. It is built with Next.js, @dnd-kit, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui and credits react-dnd-kit-tailwind-shadcn-ui as its inspiration; a live demo runs on Vercel.
contains: columns generated recursively instead of a fixed number
built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui
